title: Hot Stamping Foil for Gloss Laminated Paper

seo.title: Hot Stamping Foil for Gloss Laminated Paper

content:
Gloss laminated paper can make metallic foil look bright, but the smooth film surface requires careful foil selection.

## Main Challenge

Gloss lamination is not the same as untreated paper. A standard paper foil may transfer well on some sheets but show weak adhesion on others. Always test the final laminated material before production.

## How to Choose

Use a foil grade suitable for laminated paper. Check both small details and large areas. Small logos show edge clarity. Solid areas show coverage and gloss stability.

## Process Advice

Adjust temperature and pressure step by step. Too little activation may lead to weak transfer. Too much can make edges unclear.

## FAQ

### Can I use the same foil on matte and gloss lamination?

Sometimes, but both surfaces should be tested separately.

### What is the most important test?

Check adhesion after the foil cools, not only the fresh appearance.
